_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/session-tracker/config.json (or point SESSION_TRACKER_CONFIG at it). Keep project paths there, not in this repo.

board_gate.message: Update your row in {board} (state, last commit, next) and commit it with a pathspec.

prompts._comment: Session prompts: one folder per module under root; status in each file's frontmatter. See docs/command-center.md.
prompts.message: `{prompt}` is still `running`. Set its final status: `python3 {script} set {ref} done|deployed|on-main|on-branch|blocked --commit <sha> --notes '<one line>'` (it commits the prompt, its module README and the board with a pathspec).
